news.title: Kuwait cuts oil production as Strait of Hormuz closure disrupts global energy market
news.description: Brent oil prices could spike above $100 per barrel if the Gulf Arab countries run out of storage  space and shut down production, according to JPMorgan.

news.title: Iran says it struck UAE air base shortly after Iranian president's vow not to hit neighbors
news.description: The U.S. says it has hit more than 3,000 Iranian targets in the first week of the war, as Iran's president vows to halt attacks on neighbors.
